summary: YPF S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the repurchase of its Class XXX Notes (YMCWO) between April 10 and April 17, 2026, for a total of Ps. 14,651,877,127.92 (~US$10.7M par) at an average price of 99.54% of nominal value. The notes were originally issued in July 2024 (US$185M) and April 2025 (US$204M) under YPF's Frequent Issuer framework, maturing July 2026. The repurchased notes will be held in portfolio. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is an issuer tender for its own debt (open-market repurchase), not a special-situation equity event. What to watch: YPF may continue repurchases or hold to maturity; risk-arb angle is debt-overhang reduction and potential balance-sheet optimization.
